question: Starting from rest, a car is moving with a uniform acceleration of 0.5 m/s². The velocity of the car after 20 s is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 m/s**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Initial velocity (u) = 0 m/s (since the car starts from rest)
 
• Acceleration (a) = 0.5 m/s²
 
• 
;Time (t) = 20 s
 
• v = u + at
 
• v = 0 + (0.5 m/s² * 20 s)
 
• v = 10 m/s
